title: Refer a friend — link first, the exchange stated, referral state
outcome: Learners with no distribution channel share the referral at least once: the card gives them a reason and a one-tap way to send it.

title: Improve the dashboard so students engage more
outcome: Improve the dashboard so students engage more with it.

title: Wallet — pay selected invoices
outcome: A learner with more than one open invoice pays the ones they choose, in one action, and sees the total update before paying.

title: Deadline rail — the next four dated items across coursework, payments, documents, registration
outcome: Learners see the next four dated items across coursework, payments, documents and registration at the top of the dashboard, nearest first.

title: Ask Nexa — programme, payment and deadline questions from the learner's own record
outcome: A learner asks a programme, payment or deadline question in the dashboard and gets an answer grounded in the catalogue and their own record.
